Sara - Eng: Follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: last week's reliability incident. RCA + short action tracker here: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-18-major-fallback 

Diego - Runtime: Quick note: the routing eval used a single-window threshold which let brief latency blips flip traffic. Snippet: `policy.window_ms = 100` --> needs hysteresis.

Nina - SRE: I'll own adding hysteresis and a canary flag. ETA: Fri EOD. Adding to tracker now. :white_check_mark:

Sara - Eng: Live Qs: 1) Did Dedicated customers see impact? 2) Any immediate mitigations?

Diego - Runtime: Dedicated unaffected (separate plane). Immediate mitigation: enable 500ms debounce in hosted eval; config toggle. Low risk.

Nina - SRE: I'll prepare customer comms draft and notify Support before any toggles. Owner: Nina. ETA: Thu.

Sara - Eng: Please add observability steps so Console shows `fallback_reason` on requests. Also include rollback playbook in RCA.

Diego - Runtime: Will emit `fallback.triggered` metric with labels and add a config rollback toggle. PR will reference the RCA.

inc-bot: RCA updated: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-18-major-fallback. Actions: https://redwood.internal/actions/AT-9876

Nina - SRE: Done: tracker updated with owners and ETAs. I'll add alert: rate >5/min for 5m.
